decision: A passing performance screen admits full qualification and the full45 comparison; it is not installation or universal correctness. A failed threshold remains failed. Any separately justified engineering retention must be reported explicitly rather than redefining the threshold.
efficiency: The three-point numeric preset is optional. Prefer one robust eight-point screen when its roughly one-minute cost is smaller than preparing and repairing a potentially incomplete twenty-second run. Do not repeat timing to select a favorable result.
